crew.original_title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 2
crew.overview: Harry, Ron and Hermione continue their quest to vanquish the evil Voldemort once and for all. Just as things begin to look hopeless for the young wizards, Harry discovers a trio of magical objects that endow him with powers to rival Voldemort's formidable skills.
crew.title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 2

crew.overview: The evil Queen Bavmorda hunts the newborn princess Elora Danan, a child prophesied to bring about her downfall. When the royal infant is found by Willow, a timid farmer and aspiring sorcerer, he's entrusted with delivering her from evil.
crew.title: Willow

details.biography: Mike Potter is a stuntman and actor with a long career. He is known for stunts in Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 2 (2011), Robin Hood: Prince of Thieves (1991) and Willow (1988). He also had acting roles including Flash Gordon and Ragtime.
details.name: Mike Potter
